name: Sammijung
notes: Visit Seoul (18 Jun 2025): outdoor-yajang-style barbecue; the only main dish is samgyeopsal, with doenjang jjigae and fried rice as add-ons. Euljiro 4-ga Station Exit 1, 343 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: Jamdubong The Nine
notes: Visit Seoul (22 May 2025): barbecue in a former Han River dock; printed signatures are samgyeopsal and tteokgalbi. Hapjeong Station Exit 7, 804 m. Lot address as the official page prints it. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1385-8903

name: Seochon Daeha Restaurant
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 15 Jun 2026): fresh grilled pork belly served with kimchi, green onion and garlic on a hot plate. Gyeongbokgung Station Exit 2, 352 m. The official listing warns entry may end earlier if ingredients sell out. Official English page prints no Korean name. Menu prices are not copied. ☎ +82-2-734-9503
hours: Mon–Sat 16:00–22:00 (last admission 20:00, earlier if sold out). Closed Sundays.

name: Namdo Sikdang
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 10 Nov 2025): spicy charcoal-grilled pork, plus Korean table d'hôte and brown-rice baekban. Gwanghwamun Station Exit 2, 253 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-734-0719

name: Nariuijip
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 5 Jun 2026): samgyeopsal and cheonggukjang jjigae, with green-onion salad. Hangangjin Station Exit 1, 414 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-793-4860

name: Yangcholli
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 6 Jun 2026): charcoal-grilled samgyeopsal; kimchi jeongol and sundubu jjigae at lunch. Maebong Station Exit 4, 282 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1413-1284

name: Songam Onban
notes: Visit Seoul (6 Aug 2026): Korean restaurant in a 100-year-old hanok; dwaeji gukbap, suyuk, jeon, mandu and traditional liquor. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 6, 224 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1369-5938

name: Babjitgo Tiurim
notes: Visit Seoul (6 Jul 2026): Korean restaurant using natural seasonings and ingredients sourced from production areas across Korea; tea and house-aged liquor are also part of the concept. Hansung University Station Exit 6, 106 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1402-4999

name: TBAB
notes: Visit Seoul (11 Aug 2026): quiet cafe with coffee, ade, pound cake and outdoor seating; also operates as a rental studio. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: Musim
notes: Visit Seoul (11 Aug 2026): seasonal dessert bar with fruit bingsu, ice cream and tea of the month. Sukmyung Women's University Station Exit 2, 651 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: JO＆DAWSON Gwanghwamun Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (11 Aug 2026): Gwanghwamun branch of the Yeonnam French-toast cafe; Assam milk tea and coffee also listed. **This Gwanghwamun address only.** Jonggak Station Exit 1, 177 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: Smore Market Samcheong Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (7 Aug 2026): Disney/Pixar-themed cafe and character shop with coffee, cookies and s'more desserts. **This Samcheong address only.** Anguk Station Exit 1, 423 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-70-7116-6809

name: Yeogi Inga
notes: Visit Seoul (7 Aug 2026): hanok cafe with floor seating and outdoor seats. If a public holiday falls on Monday or Tuesday, the page says it closes Wednesday. Gyeongbokgung Station Exit 2, 339 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-70-8880-7020

name: Tiki Room
notes: Visit Seoul (7 Aug 2026): interactive cafe where guests make bungeoppang with chosen fillings. Apgujeong Rodeo Station Exit 5, 465 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.

name: Cafe Gongmyung Mangwon Book Bakery
notes: Visit Seoul (4 Aug 2026): book cafe with coffee, bakery goods made each morning, rooftop and terrace. Mangwon Station Exit 2, 152 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1363-6304 · cafegm.kr

name: Cafe Kakariko
notes: Visit Seoul (3 Aug 2026): small Ghibli-style themed cafe and capybara-prop shop in the Dongdaemun Toy and Stationery Market. One menu item per person required for table use. The page also says it closes on rainy days. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone.
hours: 11:00–18:00. Closed Tuesdays and on rainy days.

name: Shilladang Ikseon
notes: Visit Seoul (8 Sep 2025): handmade hangwa prepared each morning; original juak is the printed signature. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 4, 177 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. Menu prices are not copied. ☎ +82-507-1498-8220

name: Gamkkotdang
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 8 Dec 2025): hanok cafe built around an old persimmon tree; egg tarts, apple pie and scones are listed. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 4, 209 m. Official English page prints no Korean name or phone. Menu prices are not copied.

name: Rain Report Rainbow
notes: Visit Seoul (12 Sep 2025): hanok dessert cafe with an all-year rain concept; cloud pavlova and fresh-fruit bottled drinks are the printed signatures. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 4, 280 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-2-763-8215

name: Moowee Nakwon
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 2 Jul 2026): rooftop hanok brunch cafe with seasonal menus, wine, century-old Korean roof tiles and vintage furniture. Jongno 3-ga Station Exit 4, 124 m. Official English page prints no Korean name. ☎ +82-507-1360-0670

name: Seoul Coffee Ikseon Branch
notes: Visit Seoul (edited 26 May 2026): hanok cafe with Korean-flavor desserts including pumpkin sikhye and sweet-rice-cake tiramisu; red-bean butter rice-flour bread is the printed signature. **This Ikseon address only.** Official English page prints no Korean name. Menu prices are not copied. ☎ +82-507-1404-4890

name: Hamheung Bossam Four Seasons Naengmyeon (함흥보쌈사계절냉면)
notes: Visit Busan KO: began as a naengmyeon specialist and has operated for about 50 years; assorted bossam plus Hamheung and Pyeongyang naengmyeon are the printed main dishes. ☎ +82-51-416-2342
hours: Mon, Tue & Thu–Sun 10:50–20:00 (break 15:20–16:00; last order 19:30). Closed Wednesdays.

name: Choryang Tongdak (초량통닭)
notes: Visit Busan: fried-chicken house operating since 1976; fried chicken, dakdoritang and baeksuk are the printed main dishes. ☎ +82-51-468-2738
hours: Mon–Sat 16:00–23:30. Closed Sundays and traditional holidays.
